alex: hey team — need to swap my Sat 22:00-02:00 oncall. flight got rescheduled last minute. can anyone cover? i can take Sun 08:00-12:00 instead.
oncall-bot: reminder: alex currently scheduled for Sat 22:00-02:00 (auto-post)
Priya S: i can take Sat night if it's not a full-blown migration night. any risky jobs i should know about?
alex: there's the nightly batch + model rollout (model v3.4) at 00:30. it tends to spike GPUs for ~5–8 mins. recommend prewarm and small canary window.
alex: quick runbook snippet (copy/paste):
```
# confirm rollout status
kubectl -n inference rollout status deploy/model-rollout --timeout=3m
# check GPU pool health
curl -sS https://redwood-inference.prod/internal/health | jq '.gpu_pools'
```
Priya S: ok. do we have a scaling command if the pool hits capacity?
alex: yep — one-off scale script (infra access required):
```
./infra/scale_gpu_pool --pool=dedicated-night --count=4
```
alex: prewarm endpoint (use your redwood token):
```
curl -X POST https://redwood-inference.prod/prewarm -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"model":"v3.4","prefix":"canary"}'
```
Jamie L: note — enable canary routing 00:25-00:40 and watch the canary route for error spikes.
Maria G: i'll be available earlier in the evening and can jump in if the spike doesn't back off. Priya, please also keep an eye on token-level cost in console (we had a token storm last month).
Priya S: will do. can we do a quick pairing handoff at 21:45 (30m before start) to confirm access and run the prewarm?
alex: yes — i'll DM credentials + run through the commands. thanks so much :thumbsup:
oncall-bot: shift ownership updated — Priya S now owner for thread 2481234567 (Sat 22:00-02:00).
Priya S: confirmed — i've got the notes and the scripts. i'll post a quick summary after the 00:45 canary window.
